paite: Kuapeuh kituamseh in ama deihlam azong a, huan pilna hoih tengteng tung ah athangpai hi.
Theihsiamna ah mihai in kipahna anei kei, himahleh alungtang a kitaklat theihna ding ahi.
Migilou ahong chiang in, muhsitna leng ahong pai a, zahtaklouhna toh zumna ahong pai hi.
Mihing kam thute tui thukte bang ahi; pilna tuikhuk luangte bang ahi.
Migilou guptuam ahoih kei, vaihawmna a midiktat nawlkhin leng.
Mihai mukte kiselna ah alut a, huan akam in zepna asam hi.
Mihai kam asiatna ahi, huan amukte akha a ding a thang ahi uh.
Huauhatmi thute tanghou limtak bang ahi a, gil sungnungpen pen ah atumsuk uhi.
Anasepna ze-ol leng hihsemi a ding in unau ahi.
TOUPA min insang muanhuai ahi; midiktat huai ah atailut a, abit hi.
Mihau hauhsakna a khopi muan ahi, ama ngaihdan a kulhbaang sangtak bang.
Siatna ma ah mihing lungtang aki-uangsak a, zahna ma ah kiniamkhiakna apai hi.
Kuapeuh azak ma a dawnna pia, amah a ding in haina leh zumna ahi.
Mihing lungsim in athuakgimna apozou a; himahleh lungsim puakkham kua in thuakzou ding?
Mipilvang lungtang in theihna amu a; huan mipil bil in theihna azong hi.
Mihing thilpiak in amah a ding in omna abawl a, huan mithupite ma ah amah api hi.
Kuapeuh agen masa dik in akilang phot hi; invengte hong pai a amah ahong zonkhiak masiah.
Aisan in kiselna atawpsak a, huan mihatte kikal ah akhen hi.
Unau hihkhasiat khopi muan sang in lak ahaksa zaw; huan huchibang kiselna kulhpi sikchiangte ahi.
Mihing gilpi akam a gah in adim ding; amukte punna a hihlungkim in a-om ding hi.
Sihna leh hinna lei thilhihtheihna ah a-om; huan huai itte'n huai gah ane ding uh.
Kuapeuh zi mu in thil hoih mu ahi a, TOUPA a kipan deihsakna atang hi.
Genthei in kamdam in akhem sek a; himahleh hausa in khauhtak in adawng hi.
Kuapeuh lawm tampite bawl in amah siatna ahih a; himahleh unau sang a ginomzaw lawm khat a-om hi.
